description: This file defines a PHP class 'FilterRepository' within the namespace 'SuiteCRM\API\JsonApi\v1\Repositories'. The class manages filter parsing from HTTP requests, utilizing a FilterParser and handling query parameters related to filters. It includes methods for extracting filters from a request and converting to a SuiteBeanResource for further processing.

classes.name: FilterRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing filter parsing from HTTP requests in the SuiteCRM JSON API context.

methods.name: fromRequest
methods.description: Parses filter query parameters from an HTTP request to produce an array of filters, handling different types and throwing an exception for invalid formats.

methods.name: toSuiteBeanResource
methods.description: Returns a SuiteBeanResource instance initialized with the container dependencies.
